query:
SELECT jobs.*
               FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[]) AS requested(run_id)
               CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT
                        id,
                        deal_id,
                        run_id,
                        piece_index,
                        piece_cid,
                        bms_job_id,
                        url_tested,
                        routing_key,
                        worker_count,
                        status,
                        ping_avg_ms,
                        head_avg_ms,
                        ttfb_ms,
                        download_speed_mbps,
                        error_message,
                        created_at,
                        completed_at
                    FROM deal_sli_bms_jobs
                    WHERE deal_id = $1 AND run_id = requested.run_id
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                    LIMIT $3
               ) jobs
               ORDER BY jobs.run_id, jobs.created_at DESC, jobs.id DESC
